blockers.title: The proposed supersession omits the Semantic owner whose concurrence the DR-124 classification requires.
evidence: The unique live DR-124 row names 'Semantic/evidence/storage/lifecycle owners'. D-060 names the superseded P-005-2 owner role as Evidence, storage, and operability; DR-105 adds security/platform for the grant journal. The lawful concurrence union therefore includes Semantic as well as every role v2 lists.
proposedSupersession.ownersWhoseConcurrenceIsRequired is exactly [Evidence, storage, operability, lifecycle, DR-105 security/platform]. It contains no Semantic owner.

The omitted role is material: bytePlacement classifies the journal as 'Not analysis-affecting', and SC-OPS excludes it from Plan/Run absent explicit promotion. Those are semantic classifications, not storage-only mechanics.

Live file 04 separately requires purge to be audited, journaled, idempotent, and crash-recoverable, while only the exact transition/result/exit waits for DR-008/113. The journal mechanics therefore do not inherit DR-113 merely because the typed result does.
